# mcloud history

<!-- Generated by `go run ./internal/gendocs`: edit the source it names, not this file. -->

_Generated from the command's help in `internal/cli`._

[All commands](README.md)

List an app's past deploys, to roll back to one.

List an app's deploys, newest first, and which one is deployed now.

A GitOps app's deploys are the commits that changed its manifests
(deploy/k8s): the deploy workflow's, each pinning an image, and rollbacks.
They're read from GitHub. A direct app's are recorded in its namespace by
mcloud deploy (the last 10), with what each applied.

mcloud rollback --to &lt;ID&gt; goes back to one.

```
mcloud history [APP] [flags]
```

Examples:

```fish
mcloud history
mcloud history shop --limit 30
mcloud history --json | jq -r '.deploys[1].id'
```

Flags:

| Flag | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` |  | print JSON instead of a table (fields: docs/mcloud.md, JSON output) |
| `--limit` int | `15` | how many deploys to list (GitOps: up to 100) |
